biggest_catch: Half the payout is a $100 Disney Gift Card, not cash — it only has value if you spend at Disney; and you are ineligible if you have this card or got its bonus in the past 24 months.
catches: The $100 Disney Gift Card eGift is not cash — it is only spendable at Disney; if you are not a Disney spender, the real cash-equivalent value is the $50 statement credit.
Never spend extra solely to chase the $500 threshold — only use spending you already planned.
The card has no annual fee, so no fee drag — but carrying a balance at the variable APR erases the bonus; pay in full.
Applying involves a hard inquiry on your personal credit report.
Eligibility: this offer is available only if you do not have this card and have not received a new Cardmember bonus for this card in the past 24 months.
Confirm the $150 offer is still current on creditcards.chase.com before applying.

steps: Open Chase's official page https://creditcards.chase.com/visa-credit-cards?iCELL=61HD and confirm the Disney Visa $150 offer is still showing.
Complete the application; Chase runs a hard inquiry when you apply.
